lines.zh: 八条腿错着走，很快就过去了。
lines.en: Eight legs step out of time and I'm past.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，腿勾着砖缝。
lines.en: I move along the wall with my legs hooked in the brick.
I crawl the roof upside down.
Silk trails from me.
I walk, folding and unfolding my legs.
I go into the corner where it's dark.
I cross a layer of dust.
I don't walk straight; I circle.
I climb up along the window frame.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点僵，可还能用。
lines.en: My legs are stiff but they still work.
I move along the beam.
I don't make a sound.
I climb high on the wall and stop.
I hang down slowly.
I climb up another level.
The markings on me shift.
I hang in the corner without moving.
All eight legs are tucked.
Eight points of light spread in the corner.
I'm listening inside the wall.
I take in a little slack of silk.

lines.zh: 有虫撞到丝上，我感觉到。
lines.en: A bug hits my silk and I feel it.
I swing half a turn on my thread.
I'm honing that pair of fangs.
Something passes beneath me.
There's dried silk on the corner.
I'm counting footsteps below.
Something rustles inside the wall.
You're below me.
I tilt my head to line you up.

lines.zh: 你的头顶正对着我的丝。
lines.en: Your head is right under my silk.
Eight legs, and you see only a few.
I'm not coming down.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我就在上面。
lines.en: When you look up, I'm right above you.
I don't like the light.
My shadow presses on your shoulder.
I've climbed a little higher.
You carry a warm smell.
All eight of my legs pull in.
The thread I hung goes slack.

lines.zh: 我八条腿一时都抓不住。
lines.en: For a moment none of my eight legs can grip.
The stump is still seeping.
My body jerks once.
I crawl into the dark.
Something runs from my mouthparts.
I make no sound and draw in my eight legs.
I can still hold on.
I've noted the footsteps on the wall.

lines.zh: 那点动静不大，可我听得到。
lines.en: It's a small movement, but I hear it.
I let down a single thread slowly.
It lands on your shoulder.
No hurry; I wait for it to tighten.
Not enough to eat.

lines.zh: 我用两根腿把它翻过来。
lines.en: I turn it over with two legs.
This one died recently.
You move, and I stop mid-descent.
I reach out a leg to test.

lines.zh: 丝从口器里一线线出来。
lines.en: Thread spools out of my spinnerets.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的腿，我缩了一下。
lines.en: You touch my leg and I pull in.
I drop partway down the wall.
One of my threads snapped.
I've withdrawn into the corner.
I'm a leg short now.
I can still walk — slower.
You knocked me into a turn.
My legs have tangled.
I work them loose.
I climb up out of your reach.
There's other movement on the web.
I tap the silk with a leg.
Three taps come back.
I go to it an inch at a time along the silk.
Our legs touch.
The web sags under us.
It climbs up and settles beside me.

lines.zh: 风一晃，我们就分开一点。
lines.en: A gust parts us a little.
Then it went the other way.
Its silk still clings to the web.
I wrap it into a cocoon.
It struggles between my legs.
I hoist it up.
Too heavy; the thread snapped.
I pin it down with silk.
I test it; it's too hard to bite open.
I hang it by the web.
My mouthparts bite into its back.
Only live things are worth wrapping.
I slowly drain it dry.
There's a sound below.
I've drawn my legs in.
I press my body flat to the beam.
I slip along the wall surface.
Its head is down — perfect timing.
I've anchored my silk above it.
From here I can drop onto it.
I anchor silk at two points.

lines.zh: 它的影子正好在我下面。
lines.en: Its shadow is right beneath me.
Half an inch more and I pay out the silk.
My eyes are on it the whole time.
I drop on the count of three.
I track it from above.
It goes left; I follow the wall.
I make no sound on the wall.
The silk is already set above it.
It stops; I hang motionless.
I edge downward.

lines.zh: 它越快，我的丝拉得越长。
lines.en: The faster it runs, the longer I pay out the silk.
I'm waiting ahead of it.
My thread catches it briefly.
It tore free; I drop another.
I herd it toward the corner.
It looks up — too late.
I drop down onto it.
My fangs go in.
My fangs work their way deeper.
I wind the silk round and round.
It struggles, and the silk binds tighter.
My front legs clamp its wrist.
It dodges; I land on nothing.
It hits the wall.
I drop again.
It can't run anymore.
I lower myself from the ceiling.
The first thing I do is spin silk.
All eight legs are spread.
I settle into hanging upside down.
There's very faint light below.
I hear someone moving about.
I stretch my silk out longest.
I find a spot in the corner.
I climb up two feet.
A shadow passes below.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我蜷了起来。
lines.en: Fire catches my legs and I curl up.
I hit the floor with my legs splayed.
Water softens all my silk.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从墙上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast knocks me off the wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我的丝打穿了。
lines.en: An arrow tears through my silk.
My legs no longer obey me.
The web's empty; my legs feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我八条腿都僵了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning and all eight legs lock.
The wall is gone, and my thread snaps too.
